en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of an outdoor public swimming pool densely crowded with people. The rectangular pool is surrounded by sunbathers, diving platforms, and a tall metal diving tower on the right side. Long rows of wooden changing cabins line one side of the facility, and low pavilion‑like buildings occupy the foreground. In the background there are mature trees and several multi‑story residential houses with mansard roofs and balconies, suggesting a European urban setting. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the image side.
